title: Mensa TU Veggie 2.0
text: A fully plant-based canteen at TU Berlin, open since April 2019. It was Berlin's first.

title: Rote Bete
text: AKAFÖ's fully plant-based restaurant on the Ruhr-Universität campus, opened on 11 January 2022.

title: v²onnem plant-based butchery
text: The Studierendenwerk makes its own plant-based alternatives to meat in-house and serves them across its canteens. Registered as a brand in 2025.

title: Mensa Kunstakademie
text: A canteen without meat, with a mostly plant-based menu. Rated 4.5 of 5 in PETA's 2025 canteen ranking.

title: Mensa Neuwerk, fully plant-based January
text: Ran a fully plant-based menu for the whole of January 2026.

title: Mensateria Hubland Nord
text: The student parliament resolved in November 2025 that this canteen should reopen without meat, and that a fully plant-based canteen be examined afterwards.

title: Plant-based Thursdays trial
text: Tested a plant-based-only menu on four Thursdays in January 2026 and surveyed guests about it.
